rv.q: Rarely have I felt such a heavy stillness or such an intense concentration, than that which the audience brought to Anthony Lau's take on Arthur Miller's The Crucible.
Absorbing and fluent fresh take on Arthur Miller’s drama
The Crucible compels our attention and poses the still unanswerable question, “How do you refute a lie except by saying ‘It’s a lie.’?”

Arthur Miller's timeless classic, "The Crucible" has once again lit up the stage, this time at its namesake, the Sheffield Crucible, offering a riveting and thought-provoking experience for audiences.
So, grab yourself a ticket you won't be disappointed.
Ultimately, though, I was left wondering whether the production was absorbing or self-absorbed.

cn.t: Critics praise this timely Crucible revival for its intellectual rigor and emotional depth, with standout performances from the leads. While most find it riveting and deeply affecting, some note it doesn't fully transcend familiar territory.
